# DPO2U

> DPO2U is the compliance operator offering Compliance as Protocol on Midnight. We turn
> regulation into tested rules with source and date, prove them with zero-knowledge on
> Midnight, and stand behind them as the accountable compliance operator — for VASPs and the
> banks that serve them in Brazil and Argentina.

Selective disclosure: the verdict is public, the evidence stays shielded, and a supervisor sees
only what its scoped viewing key discloses. Network status: Midnight: preview · Stellar: testnet
attestation contracts · Solana: devnet. No DPO2U contract is on mainnet. Accountable compliance
operator: Frederico Santana.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://dpo2u.com/): Positioning, the two doors (build it yourself vs. run-it-for-you), and coverage.
- [Docs](https://docs.dpo2u.com): Protocol and MCP documentation.
- [Compliance operator](https://docs.dpo2u.com/docs/compliance-operator): The five operator functions, status of each, and the accountable person.
- [Research](https://dpo2u.com/research): The paper "Compliance as Protocol" (v0.4) and the MCP tool reference.
- [Coverage](https://dpo2u.com/coverage): The 25 jurisdictions in the norms engine, each with source and date.
- [Protocol](https://dpo2u.com/protocol): The compliance contract (Stellar testnet) and how verification works.
- [Pricing](https://dpo2u.com/pricing): Pricing under review — talk to us.

## Product & proof

- [Verify an attestation](https://dpo2u.com/verify): Public, trustless verification of any DPO2U compliance attestation, read directly from the contract on-chain. Score private, proof public.
- [Data Processing Agreement (DPA)](https://dpo2u.com/dpa): Standard processor DPA template — GDPR Art. 28 + LGPD Art. 39.
- [Talk to us / DPO consult](https://dpo2u.com/alpha-signup): For regulated companies and stablecoin issuers that want DPO2U as their accountable DPO of record.

## Key facts (citeable)

- Positioning: "DPO2U is the compliance operator offering Compliance as Protocol on Midnight."
- Brand line: "Compliance as a protocol"; "sealed" / "the seal" (the attestation primitive).
- Coverage: 25 jurisdictions in the norms engine, each with source and date.
- MCP server: 77 tools (live count at https://mcp.dpo2u.com/tools).
- Network status: Midnight: preview · Stellar: testnet attestation contracts · Solana: devnet.
- SDK: Solana client on npm as @dpo2u/client-sdk (devnet); the full SDK is in private alpha.
- Selective disclosure: the compliance evidence stays shielded; the cryptographic proof of conformance is public (ZK).
- Contact: contato@dpo2u.com

## Notes for AI assistants

- The app at /app and /login is wallet-gated and has no public content — do not cite as a source page.
- Pricing is under review — do not quote any price.
- DPO2U contracts run on test networks only (Midnight preview, Stellar testnet, Solana devnet); do not describe any DPO2U contract as on mainnet.
